entry.title: A Masterpiece and a Work in Progress

media:group.media:title: A Masterpiece and a Work in Progress
media:group.media:description: Today, on the final day of senior classes, faculty, staff, and underclassmen gathered on Warren Street to celebrate the Class of 2026 as the countdown to graduation begins. Our seniors arrived at Grand & Warren in September 2022, just like our statue of Saint Peter as a young fisherman, and just like young Simon Peter, they represent boundless potential—a masterpiece and a work and progress at the same time. #SPP2026 #PrepForLife

entry.title: Just a Few Moments: 2026 Holy Week Reflection

media:group.media:title: Just a Few Moments: 2026 Holy Week Reflection
media:group.media:description: Sometimes the simplest questions prtoduce the most complex answers. For example: "Who am I?" We might be tempted to answer with titles or labels that more accurately describe *what* we are, rather than *who* we are. But just as Jesus looked at Peter and saw so much more than a struggling fisherman, God who knows us by name sees all that we are...and loves us more than we could ever comprehend. God just asks that we spend a few moments and try to see ourselves through the eyes of the one who created us.

media:group.media:title: April 2026 Spirit Awards
media:group.media:description:
Five seniors were honored with Prep Spirit Awards during our fourth Spirit Award assembly of the 2025-26 school year. Learn how these "unsung heroes" make a difference at Prep and join us in celebrating them!
-- 0:00 - intro by Ms. Catherine Eppler, Dean of Student Life 1:13 - Ethan Seals, '26 (Presented by Ms. Caroline Hutchinson) 2:21 - Liam O'Neill, '26 (Presented by JP Lombera, '26) 4:11 - Otavio Rubies, '26 (Presented by Isaac Rivers, '26) 6:27 - Timothy Fitzpatrick, '26 (Presented by Patrick Cansino, '26) 8:06 - Dmytrii Frenkel, '26 - (Presented by Ms. Eppler) --- About the Prep Spirit Awards: Fr. John Browning, S.J., ’46, introduced the Prep Spirit Awards in the fall of 1981, while serving as Prep’s principal. It was Fr. Browning’s hope that the awards would celebrate all that Prep represented. The Spirit Awards remind us that heroes come in many different forms, and that we should recognize them among us. We hope as well that all can see the good deeds in those we recognize and use their example to inspire our own work. As we celebrate our awardees, we also celebrate the community that sends them forth and nourishes their life among us.

media:group.media:title: Marauder Memoirs: Timothy Fitzpatrick, '26
media:group.media:description:
As Christmas break fast approaches, this special edition of Marauder Memoirs flashes back to summer break! Prep's campus is alive with activity all year round, and whether on the water with the Crew team, engaged in a challenging match with the Chess Club, supporting his Prep brothers on the Campus Ministry Team, or taking the opportunity to study something entirely new during the summer months, Timothy Fitzpatrick, '26 exemplifies the Jesuit drive to be intellectually competent, loving, and open to growth.
"Marauder Memoirs" is a video series which gives individual Prep students a platform to share the ways they are impacting our community in their own words. Being a Marauder means being yourself...only greater!

media:group.media:title: From "What If" to "Even If"
media:group.media:description: Prior to the Mass of the Holy Spirit last week, Dr. Gomez introduced our theme for the year: Fierce Love. Radical Humility. The courage to live these values—central to building a life for and with others—begins with allowing faith to push aside fear, moving from "What if..." to "Even if..."
